coverage.summary: King County Code ch. 12.23 gives remedies to injured renters. The only source states no building, unit-count, construction-date or landlord-size coverage limits.

evidence.quoted_span: | King County, WA | King County Code ch. 12.23 (effective October 2025) | Injured renters may seek actual damages, up to $7,500 per violation and attorney fees. |

result.notes: The only source is a secondary law-firm table entry, and it describes only the remedy. It gives no coverage terms for King County: no unit thresholds, construction-date limits, owner or landlord-size conditions, exemptions or preemption relationships. All structured coverage fields therefore stay null. Unlike the Portland entry ('for owners of 16 or more units'), the King County entry states no landlord-size condition.
